description: Set how items adapt when their page is resized under the object-based liquid page rule: resize with the page (width, height) and pin to the page edges, plus Auto-Fit of frame content (Liquid Layout panel). The page rule itself is set with set_page_properties (layoutRule).

autoFit.description: Auto-Fit: refit the frame content when the frame resizes (graphic frames)

pinBottom.description: Pin: Bottom (the bottom margin stays fixed)

pinLeft.description: Pin: Left (the left margin stays fixed)

pinRight.description: Pin: Right (the right margin stays fixed)

pinTop.description: Pin: Top (the top margin stays fixed)

resizeHeight.description: Resize with Page: Height (the height is flexible)

resizeWidth.description: Resize with Page: Width (the width is flexible)

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_page_items, or the id a create tool returns), names, or selection: true

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

name: set_liquid_layout
title: Set Liquid Layout
